# TecnoMart - Full LLM Knowledge Specification

> Complete machine-readable catalog, hardware repair pricing, specifications, and business policies for TecnoMart (Hyderabad, India).

## About TecnoMart
TecnoMart is an authorized multi-brand retail electronics store and certified service laboratory in Tolichowki, Hyderabad.
- Physical Location: 7 Tombs Road, Opposite Fortune Toyota Service, Tolichowki, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500008
- Landmark: Opposite Fortune Toyota Service Center, 7 Tombs Road
- Operating Hours: 10:00 AM – 09:30 PM IST (Open 7 Days a Week)
- Contact Phone: +91 90106 67726
- WhatsApp Support: +91 90106 67726
- Email: support@tecnomart.in

## Product Categories & Availability
1. Apple Lineup:
   - iPhone 16 Pro Max, iPhone 16 Pro, iPhone 16, iPhone 15, iPhone 14
   - MacBook Pro (M3/M4 Pro & Max chips), MacBook Air 13" and 15" (M2/M3)
   - Apple Watch Series 10, Ultra 2, AirPods Pro 2 (USB-C)
2. Windows & Gaming Laptops:
   - ASUS ROG Strix SCAR, Zephyrus G14/G16, TUF Gaming
   - Lenovo Legion Pro 7i, Legion Slim, IdeaPad Gaming
   - Dell XPS 13/15/16, Alienware m16, Inspiron
   - HP OMEN 16, Victus, Spectre x360
3. Custom Gaming Desktops:
   - CPUs: Intel Core i9-14900K, i7-14700K; AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D, Ryzen 7 7800X3D
   - GPUs: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 24GB, RTX 4080 Super, RTX 4070 Ti Super, RTX 4060
   - Cooling: Custom hard-line and AIO liquid cooling (Corsair, NZXT, DeepCool)
4. Certified Pre-Owned & Refurbished:
   - 32-point inspection covering display, battery health (>85%), cameras, microphones, biometric sensors, and connectivity.
   - Includes 6-month comprehensive TecnoMart warranty and certified bill with GST.
5. Hardware Repair Services:
   - Smartphone screen and glass replacement (genuine OLED/AMOLED)
   - High-capacity battery replacements with health warranty
   - Laptop motherboard chip-level repair (BGA reballing, power IC replacement)
   - Liquid damage ultrasonic cleaning and corrosion treatment
   - Custom PC deep cleaning, cable management, and thermal repasting (liquid metal / Kryonaut)

## Delivery and Fulfilment Policies
- Hyperlocal Express: 3 to 4-hour delivery within Greater Hyderabad and Secunderabad.
- In-Store Demonstration: Free hardware unboxing, setup, data migration, and protective tempered glass application in-store.
- Payment Options: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), All Major Credit/Debit Cards, NetBanking, and Instant Paperless No-Cost EMI through Bajaj Finserv, HDFC, and ICICI.

- Eligibility: 1 lucky spin per device / customer
